description: This source file implements functions for managing a TCP socket object within the ANSC framework, including initialization, accept handling, removal, querying data, processing synchronously and asynchronously, sending completion handling, and event notification handling.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpBwoInit(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TCP object, currently a stub that always succeeds.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpBwoUnload(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Unloads the TCP object, currently a stub that always succeeds.

methods.name: BOOL AnscLpccoTcpBwoAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PANSC_HANDLE phClientContext)
methods.description: Handles incoming connection acceptance, allocates a buffer descriptor, sets buffer context in the socket, and returns success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpBwoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Removes a socket, frees associated buffer descriptors, updates address state, and manages connection timers.

methods.name: ULONG AnscLpccoTcpBwoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes incoming data buffers, handles message framing, and manages buffer descriptors for message reassembly.

methods.description: Stub implementation for synchronous processing, returns 'unapplicable'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpBwoProcessAsync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Stub implementation for asynchronous processing, returns 'unapplicable'.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpBwoSendComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ANSC_STATUS status)
methods.description: Handles completion of send operations, currently a stub returning success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpBwoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles socket events such as error, close, resources, and timeout, and triggers corresponding cleanup or state updates.
